title: The Tiger Gets a Visitor
skyStory: The still-full moon bursts into Aries, Joel's sign, like a firework that forgot to wait for dark. Mars, ruler of Aries, rolls out a red carpet across the sky and starts doing push-ups to show off. The moon is ninety-nine percent lit and one hundred percent ready to start something. Saturn sighs, puts on safety goggles, and settles in to watch.

reading: The full moon is visiting your sign, and the Fire Tiger can feel it in its whiskers. Today you are louder, braver and quicker than usual. Use that. Ask the bold question. Pitch the bigger version. Start the conversation everyone else has been avoiding, kindly but clearly.

Just remember the lesson of the [[Knight of Wands]] in your spread: the fire needs a target, or it just burns the furniture. Pick the one thing that matters most and pour all that moon-fuelled Aries energy into it. By sundown you will have moved a mountain, and the actual Mountain, Nancy, will be very impressed.
joel.mission: Make one bold ask today that you have been putting off, and then celebrate by doing a small victory dance somewhere private.
joel.omen: A cardinal landing within arm's reach, or a scarlet kite overhead. Mars is cheering for you, so act like it.

reading: The moon is in Joel's sign, and some of his fire is splashing onto your side of the map. You will feel unusually impatient with slow things. A queue. A loading bar. A person explaining something they could have emailed. Let the fire through, just a little. It is good for the Mountain to rumble now and then.

Use the spark to start something you have been planning carefully for months. You have done the Capricorn part already, the research, the list, the plan. Today is the Aries part: begin. The [[Ace of Wands]] holds out a lit match and waits for you to take it.
nancy.mission: Take the very first step on a long-planned project today, even if it is just writing its name at the top of a page.
nancy.omen: Someone running for a bus and catching it. Your timing for a fresh start is perfect.

together.text: Each of you name one small brave thing to do before sundown and report back with proof. Mars is giving out gold stars. Saturn is giving out a single silver one for whoever does it most sensibly. Both count as wins.
